verdict.rationale: Aleph documents several AI capabilities that produce insights from the user's own data. Scan is an AI analyst that runs flux and variance analysis with commentary on what changed and why, suggests interesting dimensions, and declines to report when it finds nothing. Aleph Agent answers questions with cited sources, keeps context across follow-ups, and can build or update dashboards and reports. AI mapping agents propose suggestions for user approval. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and deeper first-party docs beyond marketing pages (several agent interactions are described via Slack/Teams rather than clearly in-app).
